triggers.name: provider_weekly_no_overlap_insert
triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER provider_weekly_no_overlap_insert BEFORE INSERT ON provider_weekly_intervals
            WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM provider_weekly_intervals WHERE provider_profile_id = NEW.provider_profile_id
            AND day_of_week = NEW.day_of_week AND start_minute < NEW.end_minute AND end_minute > NEW.start_minute)
            BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Overlapping weekly intervals'); END

triggers.name: provider_weekly_no_overlap_update
triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER provider_weekly_no_overlap_update BEFORE UPDATE ON provider_weekly_intervals
            WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM provider_weekly_intervals WHERE id != OLD.id AND provider_profile_id = NEW.provider_profile_id
            AND day_of_week = NEW.day_of_week AND start_minute < NEW.end_minute AND end_minute > NEW.start_minute)
            BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Overlapping weekly intervals'); END

triggers.name: reservations_identity_insert
triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER reservations_identity_insert BEFORE INSERT ON service_reservations
                WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM service_inquiries i JOIN services s ON s.id = i.service_id
                    JOIN provider_profiles p ON p.id = s.provider_profile_id
                    WHERE i.id = NEW.service_inquiry_id AND i.service_id = NEW.service_id AND i.client_user_id = NEW.client_user_id
                    AND p.id = NEW.provider_profile_id AND p.user_id != NEW.client_user_id)
                BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'reservation_identity'); END

triggers.name: reservations_accepted_insert
triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER reservations_accepted_insert BEFORE INSERT ON service_reservations
                WHEN NEW.status IN ('requested','confirmed') AND NOT EXISTS
                    (SELECT 1 FROM service_inquiries WHERE id = NEW.service_inquiry_id AND status = 'accepted')
                BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'reservation_inquiry_closed'); END

triggers.name: reservations_no_overlap_insert
triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER reservations_no_overlap_insert BEFORE INSERT ON service_reservations
                WHEN NEW.status = 'confirmed' AND EXISTS
                    (SELECT 1 FROM service_reservations r WHERE r.provider_profile_id = NEW.provider_profile_id AND r.status = 'confirmed'
                     AND r.starts_at_utc < NEW.ends_at_utc AND r.ends_at_utc > NEW.starts_at_utc )
                BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'reservation_overlap'); END

triggers.name: reservations_identity_update
triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER reservations_identity_update BEFORE UPDATE ON service_reservations
                WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM service_inquiries i JOIN services s ON s.id = i.service_id
                    JOIN provider_profiles p ON p.id = s.provider_profile_id
                    WHERE i.id = NEW.service_inquiry_id AND i.service_id = NEW.service_id AND i.client_user_id = NEW.client_user_id
                    AND p.id = NEW.provider_profile_id AND p.user_id != NEW.client_user_id)
                BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'reservation_identity'); END

triggers.name: reservations_accepted_update
triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER reservations_accepted_update BEFORE UPDATE ON service_reservations
                WHEN NEW.status IN ('requested','confirmed') AND NOT EXISTS
                    (SELECT 1 FROM service_inquiries WHERE id = NEW.service_inquiry_id AND status = 'accepted')
                BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'reservation_inquiry_closed'); END

triggers.name: reservations_no_overlap_update
triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER reservations_no_overlap_update BEFORE UPDATE ON service_reservations
                WHEN NEW.status = 'confirmed' AND EXISTS
                    (SELECT 1 FROM service_reservations r WHERE r.provider_profile_id = NEW.provider_profile_id AND r.status = 'confirmed'
                     AND r.starts_at_utc < NEW.ends_at_utc AND r.ends_at_utc > NEW.starts_at_utc AND r.id != OLD.id)
                BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'reservation_overlap'); END

triggers.name: reservations_initial_state
triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER reservations_initial_state BEFORE INSERT ON service_reservations
WHEN NEW.status != 'requested' OR NEW.version != 1 OR NEW.last_actor_user_id != NEW.client_user_id OR NEW.last_reason != 'proposal'
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'reservation_initial_state'); END

triggers.name: reservations_immutable
triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER reservations_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON service_reservations
WHEN NEW.id IS NOT OLD.id OR NEW.service_inquiry_id IS NOT OLD.service_inquiry_id OR NEW.service_id IS NOT OLD.service_id
    OR NEW.provider_profile_id IS NOT OLD.provider_profile_id OR NEW.client_user_id IS NOT OLD.client_user_id
    OR NEW.timezone IS NOT OLD.timezone OR NEW.local_date IS NOT OLD.local_date OR NEW.local_start_minute IS NOT OLD.local_start_minute
    OR NEW.starts_at_utc IS NOT OLD.starts_at_utc OR NEW.ends_at_utc IS NOT OLD.ends_at_utc
    OR NEW.availability_revision IS NOT OLD.availability_revision OR NEW.idempotency_key IS NOT OLD.idempotency_key OR NEW.created_at IS NOT OLD.created_at
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'reservation_immutable'); END

triggers.name: reservations_transition
triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER reservations_transition BEFORE UPDATE ON service_reservations
WHEN NEW.version != OLD.version + 1 OR NEW.updated_at < OLD.updated_at OR NOT (
    (OLD.status = 'requested' AND NEW.status = 'confirmed' AND NEW.last_reason = 'confirm' AND NEW.updated_at < NEW.starts_at_utc
        AND NEW.last_actor_user_id = (SELECT user_id FROM provider_profiles WHERE id = NEW.provider_profile_id)) OR
    (OLD.status = 'requested' AND NEW.status = 'rejected' AND NEW.last_reason = 'reject'
        AND NEW.last_actor_user_id = (SELECT user_id FROM provider_profiles WHERE id = NEW.provider_profile_id)) OR
    (OLD.status IN ('requested','confirmed') AND NEW.status = 'cancelled' AND NEW.last_reason = 'cancel'
        AND (OLD.status = 'requested' OR NEW.updated_at < NEW.starts_at_utc)
        AND (NEW.last_actor_user_id = NEW.client_user_id OR NEW.last_actor_user_id = (SELECT user_id FROM provider_profiles WHERE id = NEW.provider_profile_id))) OR
    (OLD.status = 'requested' AND NEW.status = 'cancelled' AND NEW.last_reason = 'inquiry_completed'
        AND NEW.last_actor_user_id = (SELECT user_id FROM provider_profiles WHERE id = NEW.provider_profile_id)) OR
    (OLD.status = 'confirmed' AND NEW.status = 'completed' AND NEW.last_reason IN ('complete','inquiry_completed') AND NEW.updated_at >= NEW.ends_at_utc
        AND NEW.last_actor_user_id = (SELECT user_id FROM provider_profiles WHERE id = NEW.provider_profile_id))
)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'reservation_transition'); END

triggers.name: reservations_history_insert
triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER reservations_history_insert AFTER INSERT ON service_reservations
BEGIN INSERT INTO reservation_events(service_reservation_id, version, from_status, to_status, actor_user_id, reason, occurred_at_utc)
    VALUES(NEW.id, NEW.version, NULL, NEW.status, NEW.last_actor_user_id, NEW.last_reason, NEW.updated_at); END

triggers.name: reservations_history_update
triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER reservations_history_update AFTER UPDATE ON service_reservations
BEGIN INSERT INTO reservation_events(service_reservation_id, version, from_status, to_status, actor_user_id, reason, occurred_at_utc)
    VALUES(NEW.id, NEW.version, OLD.status, NEW.status, NEW.last_actor_user_id, NEW.last_reason, NEW.updated_at); END

triggers.name: reservations_no_delete
triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER reservations_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON service_reservations
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'reservation_history_required'); END

triggers.name: reservation_events_no_update
triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER reservation_events_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON reservation_events
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'reservation_event_immutable'); END

triggers.name: reservation_events_no_delete
triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER reservation_events_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON reservation_events
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'reservation_event_immutable'); END

triggers.name: reservation_events_consistent
triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER reservation_events_consistent BEFORE INSERT ON reservation_events
WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM service_reservations r WHERE r.id = NEW.service_reservation_id AND r.version = NEW.version
    AND r.status = NEW.to_status AND r.last_actor_user_id = NEW.actor_user_id AND r.last_reason = NEW.reason AND r.updated_at = NEW.occurred_at_utc)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'reservation_event_inconsistent'); END

triggers.name: reservation_inquiry_closure
triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER reservation_inquiry_closure BEFORE UPDATE OF status ON service_inquiries
WHEN NEW.status != 'accepted' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM service_reservations WHERE service_inquiry_id = OLD.id AND status IN ('requested','confirmed'))
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'reservation_active_inquiry'); END

triggers.name: reservation_inquiry_identity
triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER reservation_inquiry_identity BEFORE UPDATE OF service_id, client_user_id ON service_inquiries
WHEN (NEW.service_id != OLD.service_id OR NEW.client_user_id != OLD.client_user_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM service_reservations WHERE service_inquiry_id = OLD.id)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'reservation_identity_immutable'); END

triggers.name: reservation_service_identity
triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER reservation_service_identity BEFORE UPDATE OF provider_profile_id ON services
WHEN NEW.provider_profile_id != OLD.provider_profile_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM service_reservations WHERE service_id = OLD.id)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'reservation_identity_immutable'); END

triggers.name: reservation_profile_identity
triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER reservation_profile_identity BEFORE UPDATE OF user_id ON provider_profiles
WHEN NEW.user_id != OLD.user_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM service_reservations WHERE provider_profile_id = OLD.id)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'reservation_identity_immutable'); END

triggers.name: reviews_completed_identity_insert
triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER reviews_completed_identity_insert BEFORE INSERT ON service_reviews
                WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM service_reservations r JOIN service_inquiries i ON i.id = r.service_inquiry_id
                    JOIN services s ON s.id = r.service_id JOIN provider_profiles p ON p.id = r.provider_profile_id
                    WHERE r.id = NEW.service_reservation_id AND r.status = 'completed'
                    AND r.service_id = NEW.service_id AND r.provider_profile_id = NEW.provider_profile_id AND r.client_user_id = NEW.client_user_id
                    AND i.service_id = r.service_id AND i.client_user_id = r.client_user_id AND s.provider_profile_id = p.id
                    AND p.user_id != NEW.client_user_id AND NEW.created_at >= r.updated_at)
                BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'review_completed_identity'); END

triggers.name: reviews_completed_identity_update
triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER reviews_completed_identity_update BEFORE UPDATE ON service_reviews
                WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM service_reservations r JOIN service_inquiries i ON i.id = r.service_inquiry_id
                    JOIN services s ON s.id = r.service_id JOIN provider_profiles p ON p.id = r.provider_profile_id
                    WHERE r.id = NEW.service_reservation_id AND r.status = 'completed'
                    AND r.service_id = NEW.service_id AND r.provider_profile_id = NEW.provider_profile_id AND r.client_user_id = NEW.client_user_id
                    AND i.service_id = r.service_id AND i.client_user_id = r.client_user_id AND s.provider_profile_id = p.id
                    AND p.user_id != NEW.client_user_id AND NEW.created_at >= r.updated_at)
                BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'review_completed_identity'); END

triggers.name: reviews_initial_state
triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER reviews_initial_state BEFORE INSERT ON service_reviews
WHEN NEW.status != 'published' OR NEW.withdrawn_at_utc IS NOT NULL OR NEW.withdrawn_by_user_id IS NOT NULL
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'review_initial_state'); END

triggers.name: reviews_immutable
triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER reviews_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON service_reviews
WHEN NEW.id IS NOT OLD.id OR NEW.service_reservation_id IS NOT OLD.service_reservation_id OR NEW.service_id IS NOT OLD.service_id
    OR NEW.provider_profile_id IS NOT OLD.provider_profile_id OR NEW.client_user_id IS NOT OLD.client_user_id
    OR NEW.rating IS NOT OLD.rating OR NEW.comment IS NOT OLD.comment OR NEW.created_at IS NOT OLD.created_at
    OR OLD.status != 'published' OR NEW.status != 'withdrawn'
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'review_immutable'); END

triggers.name: reviews_no_delete
triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER reviews_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON service_reviews
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'review_history_required'); END

triggers.name: activity_reservation_recipient
triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER activity_reservation_recipient BEFORE INSERT ON activity_notifications
WHEN NEW.service_reservation_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM reservation_events e JOIN service_reservations r ON r.id = e.service_reservation_id
    JOIN provider_profiles p ON p.id = r.provider_profile_id
    WHERE r.id = NEW.service_reservation_id AND e.version = NEW.reservation_version
    AND NEW.event = 'reservation_' || e.to_status AND NEW.created_at = e.occurred_at_utc
    AND NEW.user_id != e.actor_user_id
    AND NEW.user_id = CASE WHEN e.to_status = 'requested' OR (e.to_status = 'cancelled' AND e.actor_user_id = r.client_user_id)
        THEN p.user_id ELSE r.client_user_id END
) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'activity_reservation_recipient'); END

triggers.name: activity_review_recipient
triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER activity_review_recipient BEFORE INSERT ON activity_notifications
WHEN NEW.service_review_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM service_reviews r JOIN provider_profiles p ON p.id = r.provider_profile_id
    WHERE r.id = NEW.service_review_id AND NEW.user_id = p.user_id AND NEW.user_id != r.client_user_id
    AND ((NEW.event = 'review_published' AND NEW.created_at = r.created_at)
        OR (NEW.event = 'review_withdrawn' AND r.status = 'withdrawn' AND NEW.created_at = r.withdrawn_at_utc))
) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'activity_review_recipient'); END

triggers.name: activity_initial_unread
triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER activity_initial_unread BEFORE INSERT ON activity_notifications
WHEN NEW.read_at IS NOT NULL BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'activity_initial_unread'); END

triggers.name: activity_immutable
triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER activity_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON activity_notifications
WHEN NEW.id IS NOT OLD.id OR NEW.user_id IS NOT OLD.user_id OR NEW.service_reservation_id IS NOT OLD.service_reservation_id
    OR NEW.service_review_id IS NOT OLD.service_review_id OR NEW.event IS NOT OLD.event
    OR NEW.reservation_version IS NOT OLD.reservation_version OR NEW.created_at IS NOT OLD.created_at
    OR OLD.read_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.read_at IS NULL
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'activity_immutable'); END

triggers.name: activity_no_delete
triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER activity_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON activity_notifications
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'activity_history_required'); END

triggers.name: activity_reservation_event
triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER activity_reservation_event AFTER INSERT ON reservation_events
BEGIN
    INSERT INTO activity_notifications(user_id, service_reservation_id, reservation_version, event, created_at)
    SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.to_status = 'requested' OR (NEW.to_status = 'cancelled' AND NEW.actor_user_id = r.client_user_id)
            THEN p.user_id ELSE r.client_user_id END,
        r.id, NEW.version, 'reservation_' || NEW.to_status, NEW.occurred_at_utc
    FROM service_reservations r JOIN provider_profiles p ON p.id = r.provider_profile_id
    WHERE r.id = NEW.service_reservation_id AND NEW.actor_user_id !=
        CASE WHEN NEW.to_status = 'requested' OR (NEW.to_status = 'cancelled' AND NEW.actor_user_id = r.client_user_id)
            THEN p.user_id ELSE r.client_user_id END;
END

triggers.name: activity_review_published
triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER activity_review_published AFTER INSERT ON service_reviews
BEGIN
    INSERT INTO activity_notifications(user_id, service_review_id, event, created_at)
    SELECT p.user_id, NEW.id, 'review_published', NEW.created_at FROM provider_profiles p
    WHERE p.id = NEW.provider_profile_id AND p.user_id != NEW.client_user_id;
END

triggers.name: activity_review_withdrawn
triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER activity_review_withdrawn AFTER UPDATE OF status ON service_reviews
WHEN OLD.status = 'published' AND NEW.status = 'withdrawn'
BEGIN
    INSERT INTO activity_notifications(user_id, service_review_id, event, created_at)
    SELECT p.user_id, NEW.id, 'review_withdrawn', NEW.withdrawn_at_utc FROM provider_profiles p
    WHERE p.id = NEW.provider_profile_id AND p.user_id != NEW.withdrawn_by_user_id;
END
